thread:
marta: FYI — after last night's KMS rewrap I see a small spike of 403s from embeddings clients. Pattern: requests falling back to chat scope and being blocked. Any idea?

omar: Can you paste the exact log line? service name and token id would help.

marta: log snippet:
```
authz-service ERROR unwrap: token=tok-23abc meta.tags=[] route=embeddings.text-v1 allowed_scopes=[embeddings:vector] -> resolved_scopes=[chat:generate]
```
(weird that meta.tags is empty after rewrap)

kevin: That's the rewrap tag-scrub bug we patched in staging last week. Rewrap path didn't preserve authz tags when key metadata omits kms-tag header. We planned a backfill but maybe some rewraps slipped through.

marta: @kevin can we block rewraps that remove tags? quick fix? :thinking_face: 

kevin: Yes — short-term: fail rewrap if KMS returns null tag or set preserve=true fallback. Long-term: need migration to reannotate tokens from audit log.

marta: How many tokens affected? Any easy query?

omar: SQL: ```SELECT id FROM api_tokens WHERE kms_rewrap = true AND authz_tags IS NULL LIMIT 100;```
I ran it — ~230 tokens in prod.

marta: :eyes: 230 is small but could be sensitive customers.

kevin: Mitigation plan:
1) run migration script to reattach tags from audit_events (if present)
2) deploy authz guard to deny requests from tokens with empty tags to privileged routes (embeddings, rerank)
3) rotate affected tokens if backfill fails
I'll open a PR.

marta: I'll create ticket in Security Ops and ping affected customers. Also add an alert on 5xx/403 spike for embeddings route.

deploy-bot: deploy-hook: rolled back kms-rewrap job @ 1998765400

audit-bot: audit: incident created incident-1998765432-kms-tags-drop — assigned to @kevin and @marta

omar: Do we think this is a one-off from last night's manual run or systemic? root cause?

kevin: Root cause: KMS rewrap cli defaulted to not copying custom metadata if not present in rewrap response. Manual runs missed flag. Fix incoming.

marta: Thanks. Please add an E2E test that verifies authz tags survive rewrap. Also add a canary that rewraps a test token and checks allowed_scopes.

kevin: On it. Will post PR link. :shipit:
